# jenkins_folder (Data Source)

Get the attributes of a folder within Jenkins.

~> The Jenkins installation that uses this resource is expected to have the [Cloudbees Folders Plugin](https://plugins.jenkins.io/cloudbees-folder) installed in their system.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "jenkins_folder" "example" {
  name = "folder-name"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the resource being read.

### Optional

- `folder` (String) The folder namespace containing this resource.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) The description of this folder's purpose.
- `display_name` (String) The name of the folder to display in the UI.
- `id` (String) The full canonical job path, e.g. `/job/job-name`
- `template` (String) The folder's `config.xml` as read from Jenkins. Encrypted secrets are kept out of state: the folder credentials store (the `com.cloudbees.hudson.plugins.folder.properties.FolderCredentialsProvider_-FolderCredentialsProperty` element) is omitted and any other encrypted secret value is replaced with `{redacted}`. This value is therefore not a copy of the configuration and must not be used as a `jenkins_job` template: Jenkins would store `{redacted}` itself as each secret, and the folder credentials would not be copied. The `jenkins_job` resource rejects a template containing the marker.
